answer: Practically, the chain should cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because summit only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, ledge is enforced in the ledger: The network tolerates clones that do real work; it only refuses ones that add no signal. Any delta approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
